observations.frame: Both complete pages inspected visually. Twelve grand-staff systems, 41 physical bars. Short accompaniment stems and half-bar bass separations are not grand-staff barlines. No pickup or split system bar. Frame agrees with print.
observations.clefs: Upper G2 throughout; lower F4 until bar 37 midpoint G2; G2 opens bar 38, F4 cautionary at its end applies at bar 39. No C clef.
observations.key_meter: Three flats, common time; no key or meter changes.
observations.route: Forward repeat before 2, first ending 12 with backward repeat, second ending 13; forward repeat before 14, first ending 31 with backward repeat, second ending 32. Final barline 41. No da capo or segno.
observations.notation: Layered cantabile melody with beamed eighth accompaniment, bass quarter/half/whole notes and independent rests; dotted rhythms, sixteenths, triplets, chord-member ties, slurs, fingering/substitution arcs, pedal down/release, accents, staccato, dynamics, hairpins and expression words.
observations.difficult_contexts: Chromatic flats/naturals bars 14–23; distinguish pitch alteration from visible accidental. Triplet grouping and voice overlap bars 8–13, 20–23, 31–35. Lower-staff l.h. text at 33; clef transition 37–39. Connected ties versus phrase slurs and fingering arcs require note-level audit.
observations.metadata: Songs without Words / Lieder ohne Worte, Book II (Nos. 7 to 12), Op.30; Contemplation; Op.30, No.1; Andante espressivo; composed in 1834, first published May 1835; G. Schirmer copyright 1915.
observations.limitations: Orientation is not a note-level candidate audit. No candidate or reader content inspected.
